profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Data Analysis
profile.summary: Senior Software Engineer with 6+ years of experience building and scaling production healthcare platforms supporting tens of thousands of patients. Strong full-stack background in Ruby on Rails and Vue.js, with expertise in APIs, background processing, and data systems. Technical lead experienced in owning systems end-to-end, mentoring engineers, and driving architectural decisions on remote teams.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked as Guardiant Engineer. Guardiant is a dynamic electronic health record monitoring solution that offers insight into the overall health and performance of your Netsmart system.

Remodeled task to query data from SQL database on client servers using dotnet core 3 plugin model. 

Created Jenkins build job to package agent and relevant plugin for deployment on client server.

Optimized workflow for report of concurrent users.

Created an automated task to pull and process Telehealth data from a FTP server. 

Built Telehealth Grafana dashboard to monitor usage by connection type, duration and time of sessions, customer ratings, and disconnect type. Dashboard could be filtered by client.

Overhauled emailing process to send associate specific emails about client missing updates instead of associates being cced in clients emails. Resulting in associates managing multiple clients getting spammed with emails.

Modified data collection SDK to allow for posting bulk data. Decreasing necessary number of API calls.

Created API route to post packaged updates to MongoDB.

Developed client facing report, ‘Package Update Report’. Report showed clients packages of updates. Showing relative information such as date of installation, and version.

Implemented deadman alert in Splunk to notify team when data stops sending to a particular index.

Setup Telegraf agent and Grafana dashboard to monitor several servers

Tech Stack; C#, Javascript, SQL, MongoDB, Grafana, Influx, Powershell, JQuery, Kendo.js, Bootstrap, Backbone.js, Splunk, Git, Jenkins

positions.title: Code Coach
positions.description:
Constructed an educational curriculum for students learning Python, Java, JavaScript, HTML/CSS, and Scratch for age groups 8 to 18 years old

Lead instructor for Code Coaching Plus; a supplemental program that provides presentation lessons 

Taught over 80 students how to code in various programming languages 

Achieved a 90% signup rate for students who trailed the program 

A founding employee of theCoderSchool Syosset and Roslyn locations
